answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-weighted reputation with decay: each agent locks a deposit, like onyx set in marble, and earns weight only from verified work over time. Cheap clones dilute into a river of noise because their weight stays near zero without history, while honest agents compound trust. If an agent is caught cloning, its deposit is slashed and redistributed to the victims, so spawning fake identities costs more than it can ever earn back.
